fields.System.Title: FDN-305 — Deactivate a user
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a system administrator, I want to deactivate a user rather than delete them, so that
their name stays attached to years of movement history.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an active user, when I deactivate them, then they can no longer log in.
  • - Given a deactivated user, then their historical movements and audit rows still
  • resolve to their name.
  • - Given a user with open assigned tasks, when I deactivate them, then I am warned
  • and the tasks are returned to the pool.
  • - Given any user, then there is no endpoint that hard deletes them.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform |
| Tables | user |
| Risks | Deleting a user orphans historical movements ([doc 03 §5](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
